summary: Iteration 2 focused on the 3 new features (Create Visi flow, Defect Camera, Milestone linking) and exhaustive button/dropdown coverage. Backend: 20/20 pytest tests pass (added TestCreateVisi.test_create_visi_from_template, TestMilestones.test_list_milestones_with_progress, TestMilestones.test_link_visi_to_milestone). Frontend Playwright: admin login OK; Milestones page renders 3 milestones with progress rings/x-y/%/closed-total, Ground Floor Handover shows Overdue badge, milestone-toggle expands to 57 linked visis, clicking milestone-visi opens VisiModal. Location Detail Visis tab: New Visi flow completes end-to-end - all 4 Select dropdowns open with correct options (template=9, type=3, assignee=5, reviewer=5), due date fills, submit creates visi and row count goes 44 -> 45. Visi modal: visi-camera-input exists with capture='environment', visi-capture-photo present, 5 step-camera + 5 step-toggle rendered; Actions dropdown lists all 5 override items and 'Set In Review' with window.prompt comment updates status badge to visi-status-badge-in_review, Clear override works; visi-add-milestone dropdown shows 3 milestone-opt-* and selecting links the visi (visi-milestone-* count 0->1); visi-add-attachment upload path succeeds with 'Evidence uploaded' toast and thumbnail appears. Filter dropdowns (status/type/sort) open with 7/4/3 options. Global buttons verified: project-switcher, user-menu-trigger + logout-btn, nav-tracker with tracker-legend-btn and tracker-export-btn, export-qr-btn opens qr-dialog.

issues: CRA react-error-overlay pops for a 'ResizeObserver loop completed with undelivered notifications' warning (benign, from Recharts/Radix). Blocks clicks in dev; consider suppressing in setupProxy or a custom errorOverlay filter. Prod build is unaffected.
(carry-over) Radix DialogContent missing DialogDescription/aria-describedby -> a11y console warning. Add VisuallyHidden Description.

action_items: Suppress benign ResizeObserver overlay in dev (webpack overlay filter) so it doesn't block interactions during manual/UI testing.
Reduce seed visible_to to a subset so trade visibility scoping is testable.
Add DialogDescription (or VisuallyHidden) to Radix Dialogs to remove a11y warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /api/visis: template steps copy uses tmpl['steps'][*]['assignee_company_id'] but does not populate the top-level assignee/reviewer defaults if body omits them - acceptable since UI sends them, but validate required fields with Pydantic model.
milestone_progress iterates all project visis every call (potentially 10k) - fine for seed but consider indexing or precomputed rollup for scale.
CreateVisiModal.jsx sends `visible_to: []` (empty) so newly created visis are only visible to owner-admin + assignee/reviewer companies - by design, but note.
server.py at 830 lines is monolithic; split into routers (already flagged).
